Treat it as the final checkpoint of the roadmap in this guide: finish the story first, clear the missable strands before the finale, then work through completion, collectibles and activities. If the platinum does not pop, open the tracker summary and look for the one grade count that is still short, because a single overlooked bronze is the usual cause. No step here adds detail beyond what the official description states.

Use the tracker summary to find any missing grade count
Platinum unlocks automatically last

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, Leonida named); starter kit guide line (52 areas)
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida; the starter data records 52 areas to uncover. Exploration trophies reward coverage, so uncover map areas systematically, district by district, and let your collectible hunts (WAiNK locations, meditation spots, vehicles) double as exploration trips. Leave the final sweep for the mop-up stage, when travel is fastest and the remaining grey areas are easy to see. The trophy unlocks when the last unexplored area is visited.
steps: Uncover the map district by district
Combine exploration with collectible hunts
Sweep the last grey areas in mop-up

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, each gang stated); starter kit guide line (9 gangs)
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang; the starter data records 9 gangs. One operation per gang is the requirement, so keep a gang-by-gang tally and prioritise gangs you have not hit when a choice of targets appears. Repeating a favourite gang's operations does not advance this trophy. The trophy unlocks when the last unhit gang's operation has been robbed.
steps: Keep a tally of gangs already hit
Rob one Illegal Operation per gang
Finish the 9th gang to unlock

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, Ocean Beach named, ellipsis as published)
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, the place named in the official description, keeping the published name above including its ellipsis. This is a moment trophy rather than a challenge: go to Ocean Beach, order or take the cocktail where the game offers it, and let the scene play out with the view the description mentions. If nothing registers, try interacting at the beach's drinking spots at a relaxed moment rather than during heat or a mission. The trophy unlocks when the cocktail moment completes.
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach in free roam
Take a cocktail where it is offered
Let the view moment play out

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, vehicle showroom stated)
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, following the official description's plain meaning: be inside a vehicle showroom, get into a vehicle, and drive out through the showroom rather than leaving on foot by a door. The style the description jokes about is the dramatic exit, so make the exit a drive-through smash and not a quiet walk-out. If an attempt does not register, try another showroom vehicle and exit. The trophy unlocks when the smash-out registers.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom
Get into a showroom vehicle
Drive out through the showroom front

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, Kolt & Associates' bowling alley named, curly apostrophe as published)
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley named in the official description, keeping the published name above with its curly apostrophe. Visit the alley in free roam and play its bowling activity through a proper follow-through, as the description's wording points to completing the bowling action itself rather than merely entering the building. Bowling also samples an activity type for Master of None. The trophy unlocks when the bowling at that named alley registers.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Play a bowling game there
Complete the follow-through action it asks for

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, partnership wording as published)
trophies.guide: The official description for this trophy is deliberately cryptic, describing a partnership moment with mass appeal, so this guide does not invent a specific trigger and present it as fact. What follows from the list itself is that partnership is a recurring theme (see Hot Together and Retail Therapy, both partner trophies), so attempt partner activities together and in public, populated settings while you work those trophies, and watch for this one to unlock alongside them. If it has not unlocked by the mop-up stage, repeat partner activities in busy public places. Its unlock confirms the partnership moment has registered.
steps: Work the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy
Do partner activities in busy public settings
Re-check in mop-up if it has not unlocked

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choice-linked trophy: make choices deliberately on a first playthrough and before finishing the story, since passed choices may not be offered again.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, choices wording as published); starter kit guide line (PSN tracks a count to 500)
trophies.guide: Make choices, for better or worse, as the official description puts it; the starter data notes PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 for this trophy. Because choices belong to moments that pass, this guide flags it missable: engage with every choice the game offers during the story instead of skipping or defaulting through them, and keep making optional choices in free roam and strands as they arise. Volume plus attention is the method that follows from the description and its tracked count. The trophy unlocks when the tracked choice count is reached.
steps: Engage with every story choice offered
Keep choosing in strands and free roam
Continue until the tracked count is reached

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, second-try wording as published)
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try, following the official description's joke that the second time is the charm. Read plainly, this asks for an attempt that fails once and then succeeds on the immediate retry, so the natural places to earn it are repeatable activities in this list (races, challenges and range attempts) where failing and retrying is normal play. Do not hunt it deliberately early on; most players will trigger it incidentally while chasing medals and race wins. If it is still missing in mop-up, fail a quick repeatable attempt once and succeed on the retry. The trophy unlocks when the second-try success registers.
steps: Play repeatable activities normally
Let a failed attempt be retried immediately
Force it in mop-up: fail once, succeed on the retry

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, wording as published)
trophies.guide: Witness something strange, which is all the official description (a startled question) actually confirms, so no specific event or location is claimed here as fact. Strange-event trophies in an open world are earned by exploring off the beaten path, and this list already sends you to all 52 areas of Leonida, 100 WAiNK locations and every meditation spot, which is thorough coverage of unusual places. Stay curious when something odd presents itself and investigate rather than driving past. The trophy unlocks when the strange event registers.
steps: Explore thoroughly for the Leonida-wide trophies
Investigate anything odd instead of passing it
It unlocks when the strange event registers

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, melee drive-by stated)
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by, the action stated in the official description and the bowling joke in its name (see also Let's Go Bowling). Set it up in free roam: ride or drive past a pedestrian at close range and use the melee attack from the vehicle so the strike lands as a drive-by rather than on foot. Speed and distance are the variables to adjust if attempts miss, keeping the pass close and controlled. The trophy unlocks when a melee drive-by knocks someone over.
steps: Find a pedestrian in free roam
Pass close in a vehicle
Land a melee strike from the vehicle to bowl them over

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, $250,000 and Marked Bills through contacts stated)
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, with the amount, the bills and the contacts route all stated in the official description. This is a cumulative money trophy, so route every batch of Marked Bills you obtain through your contacts rather than spending or ignoring them, and keep a rough running total. It pairs with the robbery trophies in mop-up, since robberies are the play pattern that keeps cash flowing. The trophy unlocks when cumulative laundered earnings reach $250,000.
steps: Route Marked Bills through your contacts every time
Keep a rough running total
Continue until $250,000 has been laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, $100,000 across all shops stated)
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, the cumulative spending total in the official description. Spread purchases across shops as the description says, buying what you actually need for other trophies (vehicles, properties and supplies) so the spending is never wasted. Money earned from robberies and laundering feeds this total, making it a natural mop-up companion to Dime on the Dollar. The trophy unlocks when lifetime shop spending reaches $100,000.
steps: Buy useful items across different shops
Fund spending with robbery and laundering income
Reach $100,000 total shop spending

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, all garage properties stated); starter kit guide line (8 garage properties)
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties; the starter data records 8 of them. Buy garages as your income allows during the story rather than saving for all 8 at once, and let the robbery and laundering trophies fund the later, pricier ones. Owning garages also supports the vehicle trophies by giving your discoveries and registrations a home. The trophy unlocks when the eighth and final garage property is purchased.
steps: Buy garages progressively as income allows
Fund later garages with robbery income
Purchase the 8th garage to unlock

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (official description, 10 vehicles and Scooter Bros app stated)
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, the count and the app both named in the official description. Register vehicles as you discover them for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together instead of needing a separate vehicle hunt later. Ten registrations is a small target that most players will pass during normal exploration. The trophy unlocks when the 10th vehicle is registered to the app.
steps: Register each newly discovered vehicle
Pair progress with Whip It Good (100 vehicles)
Reach 10 registrations to unlock
